mapper.select: WITH StudentBase AS ( SELECT account_seq, account_name FROM lms.tb_account WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq} -- 핵심 수정: 재학 중(ENROLLED)과 수료(GRADUATED) 상태 모두 포함 AND status IN ('ENROLLED', 'GRADUATED') AND del_yn = 'N' ), SubjectBase AS ( SELECT sub_seq, sub_name FROM lms.tb_subject WHERE cur_seq = #{curSeq} ), ScoreMatrix AS ( SELECT sb.account_seq, sb.account_name, sj.sub_name, COALESCE(tr.total_score, null) AS score FROM StudentBase sb CROSS JOIN SubjectBase sj LEFT JOIN lms.tb_test t ON sj.sub_seq = t.sub_seq -- 2. 이미 StudentBase에서 del_yn을 걸러냈으므로, -- test_result와의 조인에서는 account_seq 일치 여부만 확인하면 됩니다. LEFT JOIN lms.tb_test_result tr ON t.test_seq = tr.test_seq AND sb.account_seq = tr.account_seq ) SELECT account_seq, account_name, sub_name, score, SUM(score) OVER(PARTITION BY account_seq) AS total_sum, ROUND(AVG(score) OVER(PARTITION BY account_seq), 1) AS total_avg FROM ScoreMatrix ORDER BY account_name ASC, sub_name ASC
